title: Nurturing a Thriving, Innovative and Sustainable Hawker Industry as a Cornerstone of Singaporean Culture
what_it_is: Nurturing a Thriving, Innovative and Sustainable Hawker Industry as a Cornerstone of Singaporean Culture

sections.label: Hawker stall locations in Singapore
sections.summary: Of about 20,000 hawker stalls in Singapore, around 6,000 are in NEA hawker centres, several hundred in social enterprise hawker centres, and the rest in coffee shops and food courts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Of the 20,000 or so hawker stalls in Singapore, around 6,000 are in NEA hawker centres (NEA HCs), several hundred are in social enterprise hawker centres (SEHCs) and the rest are in privately-run coffee shops and food courts.

sections.label: Hawker centre rents and tendering
sections.summary: SEHC rents average around $2,000 monthly, NEA non-subsidised rents range from $640 to $3,900, and NEA hawkers tender then rents are adjusted by valuation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Rents are currently negotiated in SEHCs, with an average rental per stall of around $2,000 per month, as revealed in the reply to a Parliamentary Question by my Parliamentary colleague Mr Muhamad Faisal Manap.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: For NEA hawker centres, non-subsidised rents range from $640 to $3,900.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Currently, apart from a small number of mostly older stalls in NEA HCs who are on subsidised rents, NEA hawkers tender for the rent for an initial period and then the rent is adjusted up or down depending on a professional valuation that considers footfall, location and market conditions, as Senior Minister of State Amy Khor explained in detail very recently in this House.

sections.label: Move away from tendering stalls
sections.summary: The passage states that we should move away from the principle of tendering for stalls in NEA hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Next and more specifically, we should move away from the principle of tendering for stalls in NEA HCs.

sections.label: Tasting committees allocate stalls
sections.summary: Given the hawker industry's national significance, allocation of stalls with too many bidders can be decided by tasting committees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Rather, given the national significance of the hawker industry, allocation of stalls where there are too many bidders can be decided by tasting committees.

sections.label: Jobs Support Scheme for hawkers
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Government would consider providing the Jobs Support Scheme to hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Specifically, I would also like to ask if the Government would consider providing the Jobs Support Scheme (JSS) to hawkers.

sections.label: Discount cards for low-income Singaporeans
sections.summary: Instead of requiring some stalls to keep prices low, the passage asks whether discount cards could be provided to low-income Singaporeans for discounts at SEHC stalls.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Rather than requiring some stalls to keep prices low, which may result in lower quality, can we not consider instead providing discount cards to low-income Singaporeans – those living in rental flats, those on ComCare, Public Assistance and other similar schemes – so that they can obtain discounts at SEHC stalls instead?

sections.label: Ambassadors for hawkers
sections.summary: Ambassadors would support hawkers in navigating the digital business ecosystem, Government schemes, and marketing themselves online and offline.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The goal of the ambassadors would be three-fold: firstly, to support hawkers in navigating the evolving digital business ecosystem; secondly, to support them in navigating the plethora of Government schemes; and, thirdly, to help hawkers market themselves online and offline.

sections.label: National hawker academy proposal
sections.summary: A national hawker academy could be created and linked to an existing think tank or university for infrastructural synergies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: My second suggestion here, Sir, is the creation of a national hawker academy that could be linked to an existing think tank or university for infrastructural synergies.

sections.label: Going global and Hawker Day
sections.summary: The passage suggests supporting organised hawkers abroad, documenting endangered recipes, and designating 16 December as Singapore's Hawker Day.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: There could be other underlying issues about going global, like the supply chain for local ingredients that are hard to obtain abroad.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I suggest that economic agencies like Enterprise Singapore make it a priority to identify the more promising organised hawkers and support their move abroad aggressively, helping them to troubleshoot whatever impediments exist.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: This may come under the purview of NHB and MCCY.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: There are dishes that have been created and enjoyed in Singapore that are a part of our Singaporean heritage but are in danger of being forgotten.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: NHB could work on creating oral histories that document and save these recipes – the recipes for these endangered dishes as it were – and make such recipes publicly available, like open-sourced software, to be used and enjoyed by chefs at home or, who knows, maybe taken up by a hawker one day.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: This is currently being done to some extent under the Singapore Memories Project (SMP) and other NHB initiatives, but this needs to be scaled up and more of the recipes thus discovered should be made publicly available, with the consent of the person providing it, of course.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Lastly, Sir, I would like to propose that we designate 16 December, the day we obtained UNESCO recognition for our unique world-class hawker culture, as Singapore's Hawker Day.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: All of us could make the effort to remind one another on this day to partake of hawker food, especially with younger family members and friends, to help keep this love of hawker culture alive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: It arose organically in the 1800s as micro-entrepreneurs saw a market need and filled it, as entrepreneurs should.

sections.label: COVID-19 support for hawkers
sections.summary: Eight months' rental waiver and six months' subsidies were provided since April 2020, plus one-off $500 support in early August.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: To support our hawkers in weathering COVID-19, we have provided eight months' rental waiver and six months' subsidies for table-cleaning and centralised dishwashing fees since April 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Given the disproportionate impact of recent COVID-19 clusters on some markets and hawker centres, we will provide stallholders in centres managed by NEA or NEA-appointed operators one-off $500 support under the Market and Hawker Centre Relief Fund in early August.

sections.label: NEA centre rentals
sections.summary: Rentals are more affordable at NEA centres, where median monthly rental of non-subsidised hawker stalls is $1,250.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: As Mr Perera has acknowledged, rentals are more affordable at NEA centres, where median monthly rental of non-subsidised hawker stalls is $1,250.

sections.label: Hawkers' Development Programme progress
sections.summary: 376 participants completed classroom training under the Hawkers' Development Programme, and 96 are being mentored by experienced hawker mentors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: For example, we started the Hawkers' Development Programme (HDP) last year and 376 participants have completed their classroom training; 96 are currently being mentored by experienced hawker mentors under the HDP's apprenticeship stage.

sections.label: Food Delivery Support Scheme payment
sections.summary: NEA gave hawkers a one-time $500 support last year under the Food Delivery Support Scheme to help defray onboarding costs of food delivery platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: To help defray costs of onboarding food delivery platforms, NEA provided hawkers with a one-time $500 support last year under the Food Delivery Support Scheme.

sections.label: Alliance for Action on hawker food
sections.summary: Hawker representatives, online food delivery platforms and community groups joined NEA and IMDA to convene an Alliance for Action on online ordering for hawker food.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Hawker representatives, online food delivery platforms and the community groups have come together with NEA and IMDA to convene an Alliance for Action (AfA) on online ordering for hawker food.

sections.label: Hawker delivery and e-payment adoption
sections.summary: Hawkers can approach NEA for help, and about half of cooked-food stallholders have adopted food delivery and almost 70% are on e-payment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Hawkers can also approach NEA for help, as suggested by Mr Perera.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We have made good progress, with about half of cooked-food stallholders in our hawker centres having adopted some form of food delivery and almost 70% of them on e-payment.

sections.label: Swab and testing for hawker centres
sections.summary: MOH completed a one-time pre-emptive swab for all working in hawker centres and placed them on Rostered Routine Testing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: In this regard, let me assure you that you can visit the hawker centres which are open, with peace of mind, as MOH has completed a one-time pre-emptive swab for all working in our hawker centres and placed them on Rostered Routine Testing (RRT).
